chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Jameel ibn Salih, from Abdul Malik ibn Umeyr, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

She who is not pregnant is not returned if her master has copulated with her, and for him is the compensation for the defect; and the pregnant one is returned, and with her is returned half of a tenth of her price.
And in another report, if she was a virgin, then a tenth of her price, and if she was not a virgin, then half of a tenth of her price.
ai.seo_question: What are the conditions for returning a slave girl in Shia jurisprudence based on pregnancy and virginity?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* details the specific financial compensations (*arsh*) for defects in slave girls, distinguishing between pregnancy and virginity to determine the extent of the price deduction upon return. In Shia jurisprudence, this establishes a nuanced framework for *khiyarat* (options of rescission), where the buyer retains the non-pregnant slave with compensation, whereas the pregnant slave is returned with a penalty reflecting the loss of her reproductive value or status. The secondary report further refines this by linking the discount magnitude directly to her marital status (virgin vs. non-virgin), highlighting the economic valuation of these traits in classical Islamic markets.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Salih, from Abdul Malik Bin Umeyr, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘She would not be returned, the one who is not with a pregnancy, if her master has copulated with her, and for him would be a compensation for the defact; and the pregnant (slave girl) would be returned, and along with her there would be returned a half or tenth of her price (as a discount)’.

And in another report, ‘(He<sup>asws</sup> having said): ‘If she was a virgin, so it would be a tenth of her price, and if she did not happen to be a virgin, so it would be half of a tenth of her price’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Jamil ibn Salih from ‘Abd al-Malik ibn ‘Umayr who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

A non-pregnant slave-girl, after the owner does sexual intercourse cannot be returned but he can demand for loss because of defect. A pregnant one must be returned with half of one-tenth of her price.’”
In another Hadith it is said that if she is virgin it is one- tenth of her price and if she is not virgin, it is half of one-tenth of her price.’”
